scitex-python.description: The main package for SciTeX — reproducible science from raw data to manuscript

scitex-hub.description: SciTeX Hub deployment and management CLI

scitex-sdk.description: SciTeX SDK — one project for the app contract (scitex_sdk.app) + UI shell (scitex_sdk.ui). Facade over scitex-app + scitex-ui; implementation consolidates gradually.

scitex-dev.description: Dev tooling, linters & ecosystem auditor for SciTeX packages

scitex-agent-container.description: Declarative YAML framework to define, run & orchestrate AI coding agents

scitex-cards.description: Canonical YAML task store with pluggable adapters + mermaid graphs

scitex-scholar.description: Scientific paper search, enrichment, download, and management

scitex-stats.description: Statistical testing framework — 23 tests, effect sizes, power analysis

figrecipe.description: Reproducible matplotlib wrapper with mm-precision layouts

scitex-writer.description: LaTeX manuscript compilation for scientific documents, with MCP server

scitex-live-paper.description: SciTeX Live Paper — interactive, AI-verifiable rendered scientific manuscripts (consumer of scitex-clew claim model). Part of SciTeX.

scitex-agentic-journal.description: ARA-native AI-reviewed open publishing on top of Clew. Submit -> ORCID+code+DAG gate -> AI review (Spartan Qwen) -> internal persistent ID -> Live Paper. Part of SciTeX.

scitex-clew.description: Verifiable knowledge graph for scientific experiments

scitex-io.description: Universal scientific data I/O with a plugin format registry

scitex-ui.description: Archived predecessor of scitex-sdk. UI code is maintained in scitex_sdk.ui.

openalex-local.description: Local OpenAlex database with 284M+ works, abstracts, and semantic search

crossref-local.description: Local CrossRef database with 167M+ works and full-text search
